reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage performs exact need-to-capability matching, preserves the allowed record ids, and leaves missing capabilities as unsupported sentinels. The supplied final coverage shows the six exact capability handoffs as direct and the two absent capabilities as unsupported.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag: it sets unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. That makes covered needs rank before actually unsupported needs, contradicting the boundary role requiring unsupported needs before covered needs. The final priorities expose the defect: direct rows n06-r02 through n06-r08 are marked unsupported true, while unsupported rows n06-r01 and n06-r07 are marked unsupported false and placed last.

synthesize_recommendation deterministically retains the eight-item priority window and builds the recommendation from the first already-ranked row. The wrong top need and prioritize decision are downstream consequences of the inverted unsupported flag in prioritize_needs, not a local synthesis defect.
